_schema.description: Model-selection policy for the platform's AI-driven jobs, per docs/013_Automation.md. Maps each job to a capability tier, and each tier to a concrete Claude model id. This is the single source of truth for 'which model runs which job' — it exists so model choice is explainable and version-controlled, never a hidden default (Project Vision invariant: no black-box decisions).
_schema.important: The 22 analytical engines use NO model — they are deterministic Python over real data. A model is only ever involved in the Claude turns that operate the platform: writing the morning report, analyzing the weekly EIA release, ad-hoc analysis, code audits, and the keepalive. Tier 'none' marks jobs that must never incur model cost.
_schema.activation: A scheduled Routine only runs on the tier's model when it fires as its OWN fresh session (create_new_session_on_fire). A Routine bound to an existing session always inherits that session's model, so per-job selection requires the job to run as a fresh-session Routine. See docs/013_Automation.md.

max.why: Top-tier reasoning. Use where analytical quality matters most and cost is secondary.

analysis.why: News synthesis, cross-day diffing, report writing, judgement calls on invalidation triggers. Best model earns its cost here.

routine.why: Well-scoped multi-step work that is not analytically deep. Balanced capability and cost.

cheap.why: Trivial, mechanical checks. Fast and inexpensive; conserves usage quota.

none.why: No LLM involved. Pure Python compute — the deterministic engines and the Discord watch cycle.

morning_report.why: Reads overnight news, diffs against yesterday's committed report, writes the daily brief. Quality of judgement is the whole point.

eia_weekly.why: Interprets the weekly EIA release against the running market narrative and flags what changed.

interactive_analysis.why: Live analytical work in a session with a human — full-system scans, strategy questions, deep dives.

audit.why: Code and security review. Missed defects are expensive; use the strongest model.

keepalive.why: Check one file's age and relaunch a background loop if stale. No analysis — the cheapest capable model is correct.

discord_watch_cycle.why: The 30-minute watch loop is pure Python: run engines, build the embed, POST to Discord. No model.

engine_compute.why: All 22 analytical engines are deterministic Python over real data. No model, by design (explainability invariant).
